title: TSAI Key-Binding JWT Claims Set
description: The claims set of the key-binding JWT a holder appends when presenting a TSAI credential (SD-JWT VC). The JWT header carries typ kb+jwt. The signature is made with the private key matching the credential's cnf.

iat.description: Time the presentation was created, seconds since the Unix epoch

aud.description: The Service Provider the presentation is addressed to

nonce.description: A value binding the presentation to a request. Freshness and replay rules are specified in 04-verification.

sd_hash.description: Digest of the presented issuer-signed JWT and any forwarded disclosures
